name: A26 LiDAR Point Cloud — Glarryford (3D)
description: Airborne LiDAR point cloud of the A26 Frosses/Glarryford road-improvement corridor, streamed in 3D as an OGC 3D-Tiles octree. Rendered with deck.gl interleaved into the map: tilt and zoom in and the individual scanned points load in place; zoom out and they unload. Level-of-detail streaming keeps performance bounded regardless of dataset size. (Initial cut: 3 survey tiles; more of the corridor to follow.)
